profile.headline: Software Engineer III at Deloitte
profile.summary: Innovative Software Developer with 12 years of experience in designing and implementing .Net applications and automated systems. Motivated leader who maximizes quality and functionality by performing tests and training end users. Skilled in implementing technologies such as C#, TCL / TX, VB.Net, and MySQL. Develop and implement application systems through complete Software Development Life Cycle.

positions.title: Project Delivery Specialist II
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid

positions.title: Software Application Developer
positions.description:
- Responsible to develop functional scenarios as well as detailed functional interface, execute batches, monitor and validate defects. 
- As the scenarios are created those must be discussed with the application, policy, interfaces, and batch related folks to check if the functionality is covered to the maximum extent.s
Involved in user acceptance testing (UAT), creating UAT batch consolidated report, reporting out direct to client.
- Assist the state’s test lead and functional lead to oversee, integrate, get clarifications on queries and coordinate all testing efforts and phases, including the entire solution testing life-cycle. This also includes defining and/or refine and confirm testing approach, tools, automation and documentation.
Identify, analyze and document the Defects and Bugs in Team Foundation Server (TFS). Report the bug to the development team and line them to the specific team members queue. 
- Analyze system and application needs and analyze current business practices, user needs, and workflow processes.
- Coordinate with business to finalize and obtain approval for the scenarios related to the policies, interfaces and tasks.

positions.title: C# .Net Software Developer
positions.description: Designed C# .Net application for automation robot of vacuum system. Designed and coded several modules for automated robot systems. Lead team for .Net application development. Evaluated code to ensure quality. Deployed software onsite in Thailand. Maintained system support in factory.

positions.title: Automation Software Developer
positions.description: Designed and implemented applications based on requirements from Brocade US. Created automation test case and performed tests. Generated and analyzed requirements while communicating with the customer. Designed frameworks for 3 projects. Lead team by coordinating schedules and planning resources. Ensured completion of projects on time and with the highest quality. Implemented and documented end user trainings.
